text: {"lessons":["Selling some of Stock D and E after sizable gains felt satisfying, but I should trim according to a plan rather than sell simply to lock in gains.","Losses bother me more than gains please me, so I should watch for loss aversion and avoid letting painful feelings dictate whether I hold or sell.","With only a few account check-ins and little trading, I should favor a clear, diversified long-term plan over reacting to short-term account changes."]}
